steps.title: Point and pinch
steps.body: Point at a button and pinch your thumb and finger together to press it. With controllers, pull the trigger.

steps.title: Open the shopping list
steps.body: Every piece of furniture is in here, in real-world sizes.

steps.title: Drag in a sofa
steps.body: Pinch a picture, drag it out into your room, and let go where you want it.
steps.tryIt: Drag the sofa into your room.

steps.title: Move it
steps.body: Point at any piece, near or far, and pinch to grab it. Move your hand, then let go.
steps.tryIt: Grab the sofa and move it.

steps.title: Pick a palette
steps.body: Each card is a set of colors. Pick one and the whole room changes to match.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.body: The color wheel, briefs, lookbook and settings are all on the Palettes panel. Have fun!
